name: Mina McTianan
original_name: ミナ・マクティアナン
source:
The Communications Officer

The youngest crew member on board, she works in operations alongside Aoi.
She is uncomfortable around men and seems to look down on Daniel, Mad, and Taro in particular.
She looks up to Aoi like an older sister and holds feelings for her that go beyond mere respect.
